title: The bell for a staff login: it counts and opens the admin's Pulse; a staff login never lands on the member dashboard
why: Jason, 2026-11-19: "this happened when I clicked on the bell in the nav header" and "the side bar navigation is wrong for the type of user I am" (approved a+b+c). A staff login (decisions/0100: no member side) got the member dashboard, an empty member Pulse and the member sidebar beside a 99+ count of staff messages. Now (a) its bell counts what the admin Pulse's bell counts (critical, overdue, escalated to you), kept by admin Pulse as it draws, and opens /admin/dashboard#bell with that filter on; (b) /user/dashboard.php sends a staff login to the admin (password and 2FA at /admin/staff.php; its member account through the account switch); (c) the member Pulse in an admin-only context points to the admin's Pulse. Members, and members with admin access, keep their own dashboard and bell. FAQ.
